title: Planeswalker's Guide to Journey into Nyx

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Plane steeped in myth, ruled by a pantheon of gods whose magic is tied to mana.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: Proverbial land of dreams and home of the gods, visited by sleeping mortals.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: Planeswalker-turned-usurper god who ascended in a final ritual at the Great Revel and plunged Theros into war.

entities.name: Elspeth, Sun's Champion
entities.description: Planeswalker and reluctant hero who journeys into Nyx to confront Xenagos, hunted by Heliod.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Leonin planeswalker and Elspeth's old companion, who mentors the Theros leonin.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: God furious at Xenagos's ascension who believes Elspeth complicit and intends to destroy her.

entities.name: Mogis
entities.description: God of slaughter who sent a minotaur horde against Akros; twin of Iroas.

entities.name: Kruphix
entities.description: Enigmatic god of horizons who knows how to enter Nyx and tear Xenagos from the stars.

entities.name: Athreos
entities.description: Shrouded god who ferries the dead across the Rivers That Ring the World.

entities.name: Keranos
entities.description: God of storms and epiphany, intolerant of mortals.

entities.name: Pharika
entities.description: God of poison and medicine and mother of all gorgons.

entities.name: Iroas
entities.description: Centaur-like god of victory and honorable warfare, twin of Mogis.

entities.name: Anthousa
entities.description: Hero of Setessa who commands the mortal armies against Nyx-born creatures.

entities.name: Brimaz
entities.description: Leonin king who helped reunite Ajani and Elspeth at Tethmos.

entities.name: Cymede
entities.description: Queen of Akros and Keranos's greatest mortal servant.

entities.name: Anax
entities.description: King of Akros, warrior worshipper of Iroas and Purphoros.

entities.name: Godsend
entities.description: Mighty weapon wielded by Elspeth against Xenagos.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: Militaristic polis whose people defeated Mogis's minotaur horde.

entities.name: Tethmos
entities.description: Main leonin encampment where Ajani and Elspeth reunited.

entities.name: Temple of Mystery
entities.description: Kruphix's temple built over a cataract at the world's edge.

entities.name: Leonin of Theros
entities.description: Aloof leonin of the mountains outside Akros who become Elspeth's allies.

entities.name: Great Revel
entities.description: Victory celebration of the Akroans during which Xenagos completed his ascension.

events.summary: Akroans defeat Mogis's minotaur horde and celebrate; Xenagos uses the occasion for his final ritual of ascension to godhood.
events.quote: Xenagos used the occasion to stage the final ritual that propelled him to godhood.

events.summary: The gods blame mortals and swear vengeance against human civilization.
events.quote: they swore vengeance against human civilization

events.summary: Elspeth flees into the wilderness, barely escaping Heliod's wrath.
events.quote: After the Great Revel, Elspeth fled into the wilderness, barely escaping Heliod's wrath.

events.summary: Ajani arrives on Theros, becomes a mentor to the leonin and is reunited with Elspeth at Tethmos with Brimaz's help; they swear to set things right.
events.quote: Together, they swore an oath to set things right.

events.summary: Elspeth and Ajani travel to the Temple of Mystery to commune with Kruphix, assailed by Nyxborn creatures.
events.quote: the companions are repeatedly assailed by Nyxborn creatures

events.summary: Elspeth and Ajani prepare to face Xenagos in Nyx, Elspeth armed with Godsend.
events.quote: Now Elspeth and Ajani face Xenagos on his home ground.
